---
name: construction-architecture
description: Hexagonal architecture rules for the AML + FX system — domain purity, one-DB-per-service, circuit breaker, and API design
---

## Hexagonal architecture

Domain → Application → Infrastructure → API
Inner layers NEVER depend on outer layers.

- Domain: pure C# — no framework, no DB, no HTTP
- Application: use cases via domain interfaces only
- Infrastructure: MySQL repo, Redis cache, RabbitMQ publisher
- API: ASP.NET Core controllers — HTTP adapter only

## One DB per service

CustomerService / RiskService / AMLService → own MySQL schema each
Cross-service data: REST API or RabbitMQ only — never direct DB reads

## API design

- OpenAPI spec written BEFORE implementation
- All routes: /api/v1/
- Idempotency-Key on all POST and PUT
- DTOs separate from domain entities

## Circuit breaker

- Timeout: 5s DB, 2s Redis
- Retry: exponential backoff, max 3
- Open after 5 failures, half-open after 30s
- AML fallback: FAIL-CLOSED (BLOCK)

## Decision protocol

Present A/B/C options and WAIT for developer decision before implementing.
